# Roto-Rooter

> > America's leading provider of 24/7 emergency plumbing, drain cleaning, sewer repair, and water damage restoration services.

Roto-Rooter operates nationwide and internationally with local franchises offering residential and commercial plumbing solutions. The company specializes in emergency response services available around the clock, including drain cleaning, water heater repair, sewer line services, and flood cleanup.
